195:t_005:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin the attack. Stop the transport ships and hit $$ターミナル・ベース$$.」

195:t_005:13.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Here I go! Listen to my song, yeaaah!!」

195:t_006:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn! Don't think my castle will fall over a trifle like this!」

195:t_007:0.en:
$$シン$$
「There were still that many of them!」

195:t_007:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Hahaha! In battle, you move while looking two or three moves ahead! Did you see my magnificent tactics?!」

195:t_007:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then allow me to reveal the move I set up four moves ahead.」

195:t_008:1.en:
$$ギミー$$
「I finally joined up with $c and I thought I'd never get my turn if it kept going like this!」

195:t_008:2.en:
$$ダリー$$
「$$ギミー$$! Standing by as a detached unit in case of emergency is an honorable duty too!」

195:t_008:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn, they're not that many! Scatter them quickly!」

195:t_008:4.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Too bad. We're not the ones who will be facing your trump card.」

195:t_009:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It is what will shake your very existence out from under your feet...」

195:t_010:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-Impossible! My footing collapsed in an instant!?」

195:t_010:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「With my drill, something like this is a cinch!」

195:t_011:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$シモン$$, $$ヴィラル$$! You guys came too!」

195:t_011:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「We were fighting the $$サイデリアル$$ on this continent, too.」

195:t_011:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「We got word through $$ロシウ$$, so we came to join up with $c.」

195:t_011:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And we had them standing by as a reserve force.」

195:t_011:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Y-You fiends! An ambush is cowardly!」

195:t_011:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Someone who lets himself off the hook while going on about other people is the lamest kind of person!」

195:t_011:9.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Sorry to kick you while you're down, but...」

195:t_011:10.en:
$$チコ$$
「There's still more coming, you know. Enemies of yours.」

195:t_012:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「That's right. This is the $$トップレス$$ ability.」

195:t_012:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You sure took your time, $$姫$$. Where did you dawdle?」

195:t_012:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It took some work to break the seal. I don't know what they were doing, but it was tied up tight in code.」

195:t_012:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It'll come out any moment now.」

195:t_014:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$タカヤ・ノリコ$$ and $$ガンバスター$$... As of this very moment, we return to the front line!」

195:t_014:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「That is $$ガンバスター$$. A comrade of ours is aboard.」

195:t_014:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I see... So that's the rumored mysterious $$バスターマシン$$.」

195:t_014:6.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$姫$$...! Back up that machine!」

195:t_014:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'm going up front! I have no intention of babysitting anyone!」

195:t_015:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Since we've come this far, I'll see you through to the end. Do as you like.」

195:t_015:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Don't get the wrong idea just because Big Sis was a little nice to you!」

195:t_015:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「What's that supposed to mean, 'wrong idea'...!」

195:t_015:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Someone like you...! Someone like you!!」

195:t_015:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$! When did you get aboard $$ディスヌフ$$!」

195:t_015:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Never mind that, Big Sis! Don't you dare lose to that girl!」

195:t_015:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But $$ニコラ$$'s orders are to back up that girl.」

195:t_015:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It's so frustrating...! If only $$ノノ$$ had a $$バスターマシン$$ too...!」

195:t_015:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「They seem to be fighting already, and they've only just met...」

195:t_015:11.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...Sorry to keep you waiting, $$ガンバスター$$... But...」

195:t_016:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「To make up for it, from here on I'm going at 120%!」

195:t_016:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「That's a great shout, $$ノリコ$$!」

195:t_016:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「I can feel it over here, too! Her effort and guts!」

195:t_016:6.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Leave the backup to me, $$シモン$$!」

195:t_017:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$バサラ$$ and $$ガムリン$$, $$大グレン団$$ and $$ガンバスター$$...」

195:t_017:1.en:
$n
「With this much power gathered, I feel like we can't lose!」

195:t_017:3.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Your voice is weak, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$.」

195:t_017:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This is your reward for frightening people with force all this time! Be trampled by an even greater force!」

195:t_017:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's go, everyone! We'll blast them all away at once!」

195:t_017:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$! We will never give up!」

195:t_017:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We will defeat you without fail and take back peace for this Earth!!」

195:t_018:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「All enemy units other than the transport ships have been shot down.」

195:t_018:1.en:
$$ラム$$
「Also, we are receiving a surrender transmission from the remaining transport ships.」
